scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run sheet && vite build
scripts.build:sea: npm run stamp && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.json && npm run sheet && vite build --base=/ --mode sea
scripts.deploy: npm run build:sea && wrangler d1 migrations apply pirates-2d --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.stamp: node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('server/build.ts', '// Written by npm run stamp. Not committed.\nexport const BUILD = ' + JSON.stringify(String(Date.now())) + '\n')"
